statement: For the stated GELU and SiLU feedforward layers, every C1 conservation law under the paper's dataset-universal Euclidean-gradient-flow definition is constant.
quantifiers: every C1 function h on the full Euclidean parameter space
all finite positive dimensions covered by the architecture
assumptions: the loss-gradient span V_l is the full output space

acceptance.proof: An independently reconstructed arbitrary-width symbolic derivation establishes that grad(h)=0 everywhere.
acceptance.checker: Exact Fraction arithmetic confirms the rational-map rank for widths 1 through 8 and rejects a repeated-gamma control.
acceptance.independent_consequence: Generic sampled Jacobians have full column rank for both activations in every deterministic seed.
